text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible by default.

This ensures keyboard users bypass repetitive navigation blocks in one jump, solving a critical barrier for screen reader and motor-impaired users. The trade-off is a small permanent UI element that takes up space, but its value in accessibility far outweighs minimal layout impact.

name: Reader
text: A large, always-visible skip link steals focus from the main content for sighted users and risks being invisible to screen-reader users who rely on focus order. Instead, make the skip link appear only when tabbed to—it remains hidden until needed, preserving screen real estate and respecting focus flow. Test with a screen reader and keyboard-only users to confirm it’s discoverable and doesn’t disrupt navigation.
